mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, total, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{total}, #{status})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, total, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
